# Local engine test corpus

[Project](../../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../../docs/README.md)

Only synthetic test documents are used here.

## Origins

| Files | Source |
|---|---|
| `sample.doc`, `sample.ppt`, `sample.xls`, `sample.xlsb` | MIT-licensed Firecrawl AnyDoc test corpus |
| `chinese.doc` | Upstream MIT CFB/FIB builder with synthetic GBK Chinese text |
| `chinese.ppt` | Upstream binary structure with one same-length synthetic UTF-16 title replacement |

Upstream snapshot: `261fc257d17c3eab0f673be31c408fd9fdc2171a`.

[Upstream fixtures at the recorded snapshot](https://github.com/firecrawl/anydoc/tree/261fc257d17c3eab0f673be31c408fd9fdc2171a/tests/fixtures) · [Retained MIT license](LICENSE.anydoc)

## Generated fixtures

Additional Chinese documents, images, PDFs, and recovery fixtures are generated by [scripts/web_fixtures.py](../../../scripts/web_fixtures.py). They are synthetic local fixtures, not downloaded user documents.

Keep upstream attribution and the license when replacing or redistributing fixture files.
